name: Sketch
description: Sketch is a UI/UX design and prototyping platform centered on a native Mac editor, with browser-based collaboration, document sharing, developer handoff, version history, and workspace administration.
best_for: Best suited to UI/UX designers and design teams that work primarily on macOS and want a native design editor with shared workspaces, browser review, prototyping, and developer handoff.
features: Nestable frames and flexible stack layouts for responsive design
Free developer handoff and inspection tools

alternatives.name: Figma
alternatives.description: A browser- and desktop-based design tool for interface design, prototyping, and real-time collaboration.
alternatives.best_for: Teams that need cross-platform access beyond macOS

alternatives.name: Canva
alternatives.description: An online visual design platform letting non-designers create graphics, presentations, and print materials from templates.

tiers.name: Standard
tiers.notes: Billed yearly; includes the native Mac app, collaboration, unlimited documents, viewers, version history, and developer handoff.

tiers.name: Professional
tiers.notes: Billed yearly; adds SSO, project archiving, and permissions groups.

tiers.name: Enterprise
tiers.notes: Billed yearly; adds SCIM, BYOK encryption, dedicated support, and custom reviews/terms.

tiers.name: Private Cloud
tiers.notes: Custom pricing for a private-cloud environment with hosting-location choice and enterprise controls.

tiers.name: Mac-only license
tiers.notes: One-time license for the native Mac app with one year of updates; excludes cloud collaboration and online document sharing.

cons: Sketch does not offer a permanent full-featured free editor plan; subscriptions start after a 30-day trial, aside from education offers and free viewer access.
The primary design editor is a native Mac app, so teams that require native Windows design editing should compare cross-platform alternatives.
The $12, $24, and $44 per-editor monthly rates shown for Standard, Professional, and Enterprise are billed yearly; Private Cloud is quote-based.

faq.question: How much does Sketch cost?
faq.answer: Sketch Standard is $12 per editor per month billed yearly, Professional is $24, and Enterprise is $44. Private Cloud uses custom pricing.

faq.question: Does Sketch have a free plan?
faq.answer: Sketch does not offer a permanent full editor plan for general customers. It offers a 30-day free trial, free viewer access, and separate education offers.

faq.question: Can I buy Sketch without a subscription?
faq.answer: Yes. Sketch sells a $120 per-seat Mac-only license that includes one year of updates and can be used offline, but it does not include the cloud collaboration and online sharing features of a subscription.

faq.question: Does Sketch work on Windows?
faq.answer: Sketch's primary design editor is the native macOS app. Browser-based viewing, commenting, version history, and developer handoff are available on the web, but Windows users do not get an equivalent native Sketch design editor.
